ValidationRule.description: SS-10088: For VE record type only "Actual Date of Meeting" will be required when status=In Progress, Completed, Delivered/presented. Stakeholder: Laura Narat, Benny Fry, Colin Smith
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( OR( ISPICKVAL( Status__c, "In Progress"), ISPICKVAL( Status__c, "Completed"), ISPICKVAL( Status__c, "Delivered/Presented") ), ISNULL(Actual_Date_of_Meeting__c), RecordType.DeveloperName = "Value_Engineering_Request", NOT($Permission.DisableValidationRules ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: For VE ISR, "Actual Date of Meeting" is required when status=In Progress, Completed, Delivered/Presented.
